name: moving-pen
title: Moving Pen
description: A glowing pen-tip dot glides across the frame on a curve, drawing a luminous trail while a handwritten line fades in beneath its passing.
useWhen: A line of text should be introduced by a moving graphic: a pen, a spark, a cursor drawing a wave.
A title beat needs a soft, premium glow on a dark background.
avoidWhen: The text itself must be drawn stroke by stroke: use handwrite or outline-trace.
A light background: the glow reads best on dark.
author: Onda

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Short line of handwriting that appears as the pen passes.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Text color
variables.description: Color of the line of text.

variables.label: Pen color
variables.description: Color of the pen tip, its trail and the glow.

variables.label: Trail width
variables.description: Thickness of the trail in pixels.

variables.label: Swing
variables.description: How far the path bends away from the centre line, as a share of the frame (0 is a straight line).

variables.label: Travel time
variables.description: Seconds the pen takes to cross the frame.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the scene (empty keeps it transparent).
